# Still Beside Me

> Personalized pet memorial art: a poem written from your memories of your pet, framed beside their photo.

## What It Is

Still Beside Me creates a one-of-a-kind framed pet memorial. Customers share their memories of their pet, and a personalized poem is written from those memories and printed beside the pet's photo, with the pet's name and the years shared set into the artwork. It is presented in an elegant frame the customer chooses in black, white, oak, or natural wood. Every piece is made to order in the USA and arrives framed and ready to hang.

## Sizes and Prices

- 8x10: $79
- 11x14: $119 (Most Popular)
- 16x20: $169
- 20x30: $249

Four sizes from $79. Free US shipping on every order.

## Materials

- Archival, museum-quality print
- Elegant solid wood frame, customer's choice of black, white, oak, or natural wood
- Acrylic glazing
- Arrives ready to hang

## How It Works

1. Share your memories of your pet and upload a photo.
2. A personalized poem is written from your memories; you receive a proof within 24 hours.
3. You approve every word before it prints.
4. Your piece is printed, framed, and shipped. Made to order, it arrives framed in 7 to 10 days.

## Guarantee

If something is not right, we make it right. Refund details: https://stillbesideme.com/refund-policy
